description: Independently maintained expectedConsumerFields completeness contract for the ap-rcj.1.3.6 remediation. Each record is derived directly from source, not copied from producer-inventory.json, and lists the exact classification (current | copied | excluded) a conformant producer-inventory.json and LEGACY_STATUS_MAPPINGS must assign to the named field. Tests compare this fixture to the exact union of current mappings, copied aliases, and structural exclusions.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Autonomous top-level pass/fail signal derived by ANDing every document's independent validity; not copied from any other field.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Autonomous per-document schema-conformance verdict; the true/false pass/fail domain is emitted directly by the Ajv check, not copied from an aggregate.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Autonomous top-level MCP semantic pass/fail signal derived by ANDing every server's independent validity.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Autonomous top-level MCP strict-policy pass/fail signal derived by ANDing every server's independent policy validity.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Per-server valid boolean feeds the top-level aggregate via Array.every without changing meaning; it is a copied alias of the same MCP semantic-validity axis, not an independent context.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: Per-server policyValid boolean feeds the top-level aggregate via Array.every without changing meaning; it is a copied alias of the same MCP strict-policy axis.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: status is the canonical, already-mapped containment outcome field; contained is a redundant boolean projection of status and does not add an independent result-contract axis.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: kindOutcome reports a filesystem-kind observation (match/missing/mismatch against an expected file-vs-directory kind), not an operation, evaluation, evidence, or approval axis.

records.creator: skill-creator
records.rationale: train_results carries the same results[].pass boolean verdict already inventoried under skill-trigger-result-pass; it is a copied split view of the train subset, not a new context.

records.creator: skill-creator
records.rationale: test_results carries the same results[].pass boolean verdict already inventoried under skill-trigger-result-pass; it is a copied split view of the held-out subset, not a new context.

records.creator: skill-creator
records.rationale: The top-level results field is a backward-compatible fallback alias of train_results (consumed via first.train_results ?? first.results in generate_report.ts) carrying the identical pass boolean; it copies the skill-trigger-result-pass axis rather than introducing one.

records.creator: skill-creator
records.rationale: The improvement prompt renders PASS/FAIL directly from the same results[].pass boolean captured by run_loop history; it is a copied alias of skill-trigger-result-pass used for prompt rendering, not a new verdict domain.

records.creator: plugin-creator
records.rationale: The portable-load CLI branch forwards ValidationOutcome.status verbatim into its JSON envelope and derives ok from it; it is a copied alias of plugin-validation-outcome, not an independent status domain.
